name: Basin and petroleum systems modelling
principle: Software reconstructs burial, heat flow and fluid flow in a sedimentary basin to estimate when and where source rocks generated oil or gas, how it migrated and whether a trap was in place. The general framework is source rock, burial heat, migration, reservoir, seal and trap.

process_steps.name: Assemble geology, thermal history and kinetics
Predict charge, timing and fluid type

source.note: Wikipedia, Petroleum system (petroleum geology), read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

performance.metric: model dimensions documented for petroleum systems modeling workflows (PetroMod)
performance.basis: USGS OFR 2006-1024 documents the PetroMod workflow (1D to 3D) with calibration data from source-rock pyrolysis (kerogen type, TOC, HI, kinetics) and well thermal data; SLB documents heat flow calibration to well temperature and vitrinite reflectance and the PetroRisk uncertainty module; example result: migration flowpaths and accumulations modeled for the Mannville petroleum system, Western Canada Sedimentary Basin

source.note: USGS Open-File Report 2006-1024, 2006; calibration and uncertainty detail from SLB Petromod product page (read 28 October 2026)

advantages: Links timing of charge to trap formation
limitations: The Wikipedia page read describes the geological framework, not modelling workflows or accuracy
